modules.speech-synthesis.click_an_ipa_sy: Click an IPA symbol to copy it. Spaces are silent intervals. +, −, *, / multiply relative duration by 1.1, 0.9, 2, 0.5 respectively, then durations are normalized to the total. Generating vowels updates formants and silent intervals, preserving the current phonation preset and F0 curve.

modules.speech-synthesis.shift_drag_to_d: Shift-drag to draw, Ctrl-drag to restore defaults, drag normally to pan, and Ctrl-wheel to zoom. Overrides support a single value, comma-separated gradients, and semicolon-separated intervals. Clear overrides to resume drawing. Shimmer is displayed as a percentage and stored as a decimal. Dashed F1–F5 curves show other formants as read-only references.
modules.speech-synthesis.applying_durati: Applying duration immediately updates both plots' time axes. Old audio is displayed at its actual time, with empty space past its end. Resynthesize for audio at the new duration.
modules.speech-synthesis.export_paramete: Export parameters saves the current configuration. Export audio saves the last synthesis result; desktop folder saving also includes the actual synthesis parameters and metadata. Complete CSV retains sample rate, fades, silence, and underlying curves beneath overrides.
modules.speech-synthesis.select_an_f0_ex: Select an F0 extraction algorithm in the toolbar before loading WAV: Praat cross-correlation CC, autocorrelation AC, or REAPER. After switching, click Extract parameters to recompute with applied F0 bounds on the left. Unavailable REAPER raises an error without switching algorithms automatically. Older m06/2 files default to the original Praat CC.
modules.speech-synthesis.the_bottom_time: The bottom time selection, playback progress, and volume follow the source audio or synthesized result currently being previewed.
modules.speech-synthesis.selecting_wav_o: Selecting WAV on the left loads a preview only. Curves update when Extract parameters is clicked. Extraction requires loaded audio and retains the source sample rate. Copy synthesis and five phonation presets set synthesis controls; measure output features again using Parameter estimation. AV and AH control periodic excitation and airflow noise respectively, ranging from 0–80 dB; 0 disables that source. 60 dB uses this tool's digital reference. HNR, H1–H2, and Slope adjust sound through extended processing; remeasure output acoustic values. Physical sound-pressure research requires separate calibration. Falsetto shifts the base F0 curve up to a mean of at least 300 Hz; creaky voice shifts it down to about 70 Hz while retaining a 20 Hz minimum. Modal voice, whisper, and breathy voice remove the shift, retaining edits made while shifted. Reapplying the same preset does not accumulate shifts. Current tasks are limited to 10 seconds and 480,000 samples.
